svg.title: Whisper Transcriber Suite — The Local Monolith
svg.desc: Animated promo for Whisper Transcriber Suite: free and open source offline speech-to-text running OpenAI Whisper locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Transforms audio interviews, lectures, video links, and live microphone speech into speaker-labeled transcripts, timed subtitles, and 14 export formats (.srt, .vtt, .docx, .pdf) directly on your computer.

g.text: Your audio stays on your computer.
